_envelope._assertion: Reject — Per docs/integrations/revel/field_mapping.md 'Timestamp shapes': if the sandbox surface ever emits location-local timestamps with no offset, the adapter REFUSES the event at parse time (drops with connector_sync_log.event_kind = parse_error); it does NOT silently re-interpret. The naive timestamp `2026-05-02 19:31:00` (no `T`, no `Z`, no offset) is the documented refuse-path. RevelPosAdapter._parseUtc returns null because DateTime.tryParse on this shape is platform-dependent, and even when it parses, treating it as UTC would silently mis-bucket the operator's day. Adapter must reject, not best-effort.
